card.name: Leading digit of a percentage
card.fires_on: The first digit of a percentage written inside parentheses after a patient count, as in 29/355 (8%) or 125 (9.1). It also fires on a leading digit in other counts or shares.

modes.label: Percent after count
modes.description: A single digit that starts a percentage in parentheses following a count of patients or events.

modes.label: Percent with decimal
modes.description: A leading digit that is followed by a decimal point in a table or results line.

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a percentage given in brackets after a patient count in results.
